title: Classifieds Scrapers: Marketplace, Leboncoin, Kleinanzeigen
metaDescription: Scrape classified ads from Facebook Marketplace, leboncoin.fr and Kleinanzeigen.de: price, location, photos, seller and category details, no login.
intro: Track second-hand prices and new ads on the big classifieds sites. Paste a search link, or a keyword and a city, and get every ad with price, location, seller and the category fields (cars, property, electronics) as data.
